title: SessionCompact
description: Compact the session's context now (between tasks, shared-members.md §5.3). The daemon runs it when the session is between turns and answers session.compacted; the stored task anchor is cleared (the task it belonged to is over).

compact_id.description: Chosen by the console; session.compacted echoes it.

instructions.description: What the summary must keep (Claude: /compact <instructions>; Codex has no instructions and ignores it).
